name: Kneeling Kickbacks on the Box
summary: On hands and knees on the long box, facing the straps, with a long loop around one foot. The leg presses straight back and bends in again.
steps: Kneel on the box facing the back of the reformer, hands on the top corners.
Hook a long loop around the arch of one foot.
Supporting knee in the middle of the back edge, working knee beside it.
Breathe out to send the leg straight behind; breathe in to bend it back in.

layers.title: Straight-leg sweep
layers.text: Leg stays long and sweeps out to the side of the box and back.

layers.title: Circles
layers.text: Small circles with the leg long.

modifications: Lighter spring, or no strap at all.
Forearms on the box for sore wrists.

cautions.note: Keep the leg low and the ribs drawn in.

cues:
Lift from the crease under the buttock.
Stop before the lower back arches — the leg doesn't need to go high.
Hips and shoulders stay square to the box.
Push the box away to keep the shoulders wide.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
